text.2:252: These are the portents of Allah which We recite unto thee (Muhammad) with truth, and lo! thou art of the number of (Our) messengers;
text.6:34: Messengers indeed have been denied before thee, and they were patient under the denial and the persecution till Our succour reached them. There is none to alter the decisions of Allah. Already there hath reached thee (somewhat) of the tidings of the messengers (We sent before).
text.6:48: We send not the messengers save as bearers of good news and warners. Whoso believeth and doeth right, there shall no fear come upon them neither shall they grieve.
text.7:6: Then verily We shall question those unto whom (Our message) hath been sent, and verily We shall question the messengers.
text.7:75: The chieftains of his people, who were scornful, said unto those whom they despised, unto such of them as believed: Know ye that Salih is one sent from his Lord? They said: Lo! In that wherewith he hath been sent we are believers.
text.7:77: So they hamstrung the she-camel, and they flouted the commandment of their Lord, and they said: O Salih! Bring upon us that thou threatenest if thou art indeed of those sent (from Allah).
text.13:43: They who disbelieve say: Thou art no messenger (of Allah). Say: Allah, and whosoever hath knowledge of the Scripture, is sufficient witness between me and you.
text.15:57: He said: And afterward what is your business, O ye messengers (of Allah)?
text.15:61: And when the messengers came unto the family of Lot,
text.15:80: And the dwellers in Al-Hijr denied (Our) messengers.
text.18:56: We send not the messengers save as bearers of good news and warners. Those who disbelieve contend with falsehood in order to refute the Truth thereby. And they take Our revelations and that wherewith they are threatened as a jest.
text.25:20: We never sent before thee any messengers but lo! they verily ate food and walked in the markets. And We have appointed some of you a test for others: Will ye be steadfast? And thy Lord is ever Seer.
text.26:21: Then I fled from you when I feared you, and my Lord vouchsafed me a command and appointed me (of the number) of those sent (by Him).
text.26:105: Noah's folk denied the messengers (of Allah),
text.26:123: (The tribe of) A'ad denied the messengers (of Allah).
text.26:141: (The tribe of) Thamud denied the messengers (of Allah)
text.26:160: The folk of Lot denied the messengers (of Allah),
text.26:176: The dwellers in the wood (of Midian) denied the messengers (of Allah),
text.27:10: And throw down thy staff! But when he saw it writhing as it were a demon, he turned to flee headlong; (but it was said unto him): O Moses! Fear not! the emissaries fear not in My presence,
text.27:35: But lo! I am going to send a present unto them, and to see with what (answer) the messengers return.
text.28:7: And We inspired the mother of Moses, saying: Suckle him and, when thou fearest for him, then cast him into the river and fear not nor grieve. Lo! We shall bring him back unto thee and shall make him (one) of Our messengers.
text.28:65: And on the Day when He will call unto them and say: What answer gave ye to the messengers?
text.36:3: Lo! thou art of those sent
text.36:13: Coin for them a similitude: The people of the city when those sent (from Allah) came unto them;
text.36:14: When We sent unto them twain, and they denied them both, so We reinforced them with a third, and they said: Lo! we have been sent unto you.
text.36:16: They answered: Our Lord knoweth that we are indeed sent unto you,
text.36:20: And there came from the uttermost part of the city a man running. He cried: O my people! Follow those who have been sent!
text.36:52: Crying: Woe upon us! Who hath raised us from our place of sleep? This is that which the Beneficent did promise, and the messengers spoke truth.
text.37:37: Nay, but he brought the Truth, and he confirmed those sent (before him).
text.37:123: And lo! Elias was of those sent (to warn),
text.37:133: And lo! Lot verily was of those sent (to warn).
text.37:139: And lo! Jonah verily was of those sent (to warn)
text.37:171: And verily Our word went forth of old unto Our bondmen sent (to warn)
text.37:181: And peace be unto those sent (to warn).
text.51:31: (Abraham) said: And (afterward) what is your errand, O ye sent (from Allah)?
